Our story

It started with
a kitchen table.

Two friends. One conviction: the best work comes from being in it together.

In 2016, Maya and Oliver traded agency silos for a small shared table. They wanted a practice where strategy sat beside design, clients joined the conversation, and everyone had a voice.

Today, that table is a little longer. Our curiosity hasn’t changed. We partner with people building a more thoughtful world, making brands and digital experiences that earn their place in it.

2016

Two founders and a first independent project.

2019

A studio of eight, and our first international partnership.

2022

A flexible studio, connected across three time zones.

Today

Twenty-four people. A shared belief in better.

What brings us together

Make meaningful things.
With people who care.

We help purpose-led businesses find their voice and turn it into work people can feel. Our measure of success is a stronger business and a more useful, considered experience for its community.

Stay curious.

Better questions make better work. Every project starts with listening, not a prewritten answer.

Make it together.

Good ideas have no job title. Open critiques and weekly client sessions keep everyone involved.

Care deeply.

The small details are the big picture. We make time for craft, accessibility and honest feedback.

Do the right thing.

We say what we mean. Clear budgets, responsible partners and candid conversations come first.

Many perspectives.
One common ground.

Life at Common Ground

Room to do your best.
Space to be yourself.

Tuesday lunches, Friday show-and-tells, and the occasional very competitive pottery class. We take our work seriously. Ourselves? A little less.

Our hybrid rhythm is built on trust: two shared studio days, focus time wherever you thrive, and flexible hours around the rest of life.

A good place to grow.

Annual learning allowance. Mentorship across disciplines. Protected focus time. Thirty days off. Flexible working. And a warm welcome for four-legged colleagues.
